title: Wakir Datalog Caveat (Phase 1a Wirelang vocabulary v0.1)
description: JSON Schema for the array of Datalog caveat statements that can appear inside a Layer-3 capability token's authority_block.caveats and append_blocks[*].caveats. The schema encodes the Wakir Phase-1a vocabulary registered in wirelang/specs/datalog-caveat-vocabulary.md, validating predicate name and arity. Predicate-argument-type checking beyond the surface syntax is performed at Biscuit-Datalog evaluation time, not by this schema. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

items.description: A single Datalog caveat statement. Wakir Phase-1a vocabulary recognises 20 predicates (see datalog-caveat-vocabulary.md). The pattern below admits `<predicate>(<arg-list>)` syntax where the predicate is one of the registered Wakir predicates and the argument list contains the expected number of comma-separated tokens. Variable references are written `$name`. Caveats that compose multiple predicates (e.g. `time($t), $t < 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z`) are admitted as a comma-separated chain.

$comment: The pattern restricts the leading predicate name to the registered Wakir vocabulary. Argument-list contents are deliberately permissive (`[^)]*`) because Datalog supports a rich set of argument forms (literals, variables, comparators); type-level validation lives in the Biscuit-Datalog evaluator. This schema is the syntactic gate for static-analysis tooling and registry-side checks; it is NOT the security boundary.
